mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (name, description, parent_id, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{parentId}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM categories WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM categories ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM categories WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM categories ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM categories
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM categories WHERE parent_id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM products WHERE category_id = #{id}

WITH RECURSIVE category_tree AS ( SELECT id, parent_id, name FROM categories WHERE id = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, c.name FROM categories c INNER JOIN category_tree ct ON c.id = ct.parent_id ) SELECT id, parent_id, name FROM category_tree ORDER BY parent_id DESC
SELECT * FROM categories WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY parent_id ASC, sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM categories WHERE parent_id = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

WITH RECURSIVE category_tree AS ( SELECT id, parent_id, name FROM categories WHERE parent_id = 0 UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, c.name FROM categories c INNER JOIN category_tree ct ON c.parent_id = ct.id ) SELECT * FROM categories WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM category_tree WHERE LENGTH(REPLACE(id ->> '$', '.', '')) - LENGTH(id ->> '$') + 1 = #{level} ) AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

WITH RECURSIVE category_tree AS ( SELECT id, parent_id, 1 as depth FROM categories WHERE id = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, ct.depth + 1 as depth FROM categories c INNER JOIN category_tree ct ON c.id = ct.parent_id ) SELECT MAX(depth) FROM category_tree

WITH RECURSIVE category_tree AS ( SELECT id, parent_id, name FROM categories WHERE id = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, c.name FROM categories c INNER JOIN category_tree ct ON c.id = ct.parent_id ) SELECT id, parent_id, name FROM category_tree ORDER BY parent_id DESC

SELECT c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, COUNT(p.id) as product_count, AVG(p.price) as average_price, MIN(p.price) as min_price, MAX(p.price) as max_price FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY product_count DESC

SELECT c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, COUNT(child.id) as child_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN categories child ON c.id = child.parent_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY child_count DESC

SELECT level, COUNT(*) as category_count FROM ( SELECT id, (LENGTH(parent_id_path) - LENGTH(REPLACE(parent_id_path, '.', ''))) + 1 as level FROM ( SELECT id, IF(parent_id = 0, '0', CONCAT_WS('.', (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(parent_id ORDER BY parent_id DESC SEPARATOR '.') FROM categories WHERE FIND_IN_SET(id, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(parent_id ORDER BY parent_id DESC SEPARATOR ',') FROM categories WHERE id = c.id))) ) ) as parent_id_path FROM categories c ) as category_with_level GROUP BY level ) as level_stats ORDER BY level
SELECT id, name FROM categories WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY name

SELECT id, name, parent_id, CONCAT_WS(' > ', (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(name ORDER BY parent_id DESC SEPARATOR ' > ') FROM categories WHERE FIND_IN_SET(id, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(parent_id ORDER BY parent_id DESC SEPARATOR ',') FROM categories WHERE id = c.id))) ) as path FROM categories c WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY path
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM categories GROUP BY status
SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM categories WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date

update.foreach: UPDATE categories SET sort_order = #{sortOrders[index]}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{categoryId}
UPDATE categories SET status = #{statuses[index]}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{categoryId}

mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.* FROM categories c INNER JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.id = #{productId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.id ASC
